content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often overlook regions such as Kenya, Nigeria, and Pakistan, leaving creators without viable options. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you bypass these limitations entirely. By utilizing blockchain technology, you gain access to instant payment processing and ownership of your data. This approach ensures that you are not dependent on any single platform, which minimizes risk and maximizes control over your sales.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your ecommerce stack, ensure you have the necessary components. Start by signing up for a Cloudflare account to host your site and utilize their services. You will also need a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions, and a storage solution such as Google Drive or Supabase for your product files. Familiarize yourself with blockchain payment methods, especially those that have low transaction fees and fast settlement times, like USDT on Tron.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, begin with configuring your NOWPayments account to accept cryptocurrencies. Next, connect your payment gateway to your website hosted on Cloudflare. Ensure your products are stored securely in your chosen storage solution, ready for instant delivery upon payment confirmation. This entire process should be automated, allowing you to focus on creating rather than managing transactions.
Blockchain payments eliminate geographical barriers for digital creators.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is in place, it's time to launch. Promote your ebook to your audience, ensuring they understand the payment options available through cryptocurrencies. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments webhook will automatically trigger, confirming payment on-chain. This process should take under 60 seconds with minimal fees, allowing you to deliver your product immediately through the automated system you've set up.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing a successful ecommerce operation, consider how to scale. You can increase your product offerings by adding more ebooks, courses, or templates. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional resources and templates that allow you to streamline your operations further. Focus on marketing and expanding your reach to international buyers who are eager for quality digital content.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Creators in Africa can sell digital products internationally by using blockchain-based payment solutions like NOWPayments. These platforms offer support for various cryptocurrencies, eliminating the need for traditional banking systems that often exclude many regions. By implementing this infrastructure, you can access a global market while maintaining full control over your sales.
You own your infrastructure, ensuring full control over your sales.

This guide connects directly to related searches, highlighting how to sell ebooks in Nigeria without PayPal and exploring digital product stores in Ghana. For comprehensive resources, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to build your sovereign digital commerce stack. Access it at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are the best payment methods for selling ebooks in Kenya?
The best payment methods for selling ebooks in Kenya include cryptocurrencies like USDT on Tron and using NOWPayments, which offer low fees and instant transaction confirmations.
Can I use Binance P2P to sell my digital products?
Yes, Binance P2P supports local currencies like Kenyan shillings and Pakistani rupees, allowing you to sell your digital products while receiving payments in your local currency.
How do I ensure my ebook delivery is automated?
To automate ebook delivery, set up a webhook with NOWPayments that triggers an email or file delivery the moment a payment is confirmed on-chain.
Is it possible to scale my ebook business without additional costs?
Yes, by utilizing the Complete Builder Kit, you can scale your ebook business without incurring additional costs for separate templates or blueprints.
What steps should I take if I face payment processing issues?
If you encounter payment processing issues, review your NOWPayments integration, ensure your crypto wallet is correctly configured, and check your storage solution for product accessibility.
